summary: A victim seeking remote work was recruited for a supposed financial operations role involving crypto payment processing. The scammers gradually built trust through small transfers before convincing the victim to send approximately 290000 dollars of personal funds to crypto wallets under the promise of reimbursement.
user_mistake: Sent personal funds to fulfill payment requests for an unverified remote employer
prevention: Reject jobs requiring personal financial transfers or crypto conversions/Verify employer identity and business registration independently before handling payments
